rappel_detail.anchor: natural: horn, chockstone or a sling around a block; no fixed anchor reported
rappel_detail.station: The steeper step in the connecting gully to the large notch about a third of the way down the ridge (about 7,600-7,700 ft).
rappel_detail.notes: Optional single-strand rappel on one 30 m rope; most parties downclimb the step as Class 4 on solid holds.

set.rappels: 1 optional single-strand rappel on a 30 m rope over the steep step in the gully to the ridge notch; most parties downclimb it
